幹.title: tree trunk; main part
幹.disposition: Morning, dry and grass do not give trunk/main-part senses. 木 is excluded as a curated wrong answer because tree/wood is too close; its legacy three-choice set is already complete.

氏.title: clan; family name
氏.disposition: Populace, paper and low do not give family-name/clan/suffix senses. 姓 is an explicit comparison, not a wrong option; its existing three curated distractors remain unchanged.

凹.title: concave; sunken
凹.disposition: Convex/protruding is the reverse direction, not the target's hollow/dent sense; revolve/times and same/equal are distinct. Neither new direction title overlaps the other's ordinary meaning.

凸.title: convex; protruding
凸.disposition: Concave/sunken is the reverse direction; revolve/times and same/equal are distinct. Existing support-word titles and exclusions are unchanged.

扱.title: handle; deal with
扱.disposition: Inhale/suck in, slope and throw do not give handling/treatment or stripping senses. Potentially overlapping management character 営 already has three curated wrong choices; no legacy fallback change needed.

乃.title: thereupon; possessive no
乃.disposition: Nine, ten thousand and power do not supply the connecting, second-person or particle/sound senses.

矛.title: spear; polearm
矛.disposition: Beforehand, duties and soft/supple are distinct from spear, broad arms and the contextual float sense. Shield is a comparison, not curated as wrong against the broader arms sense.

鷹.title: hawk; falcon
鷹.disposition: Animal call/ring, island and cloud do not mean this bird. 鳥 is too broad to curate as a wrong answer.

彗.title: broom; comet
彗.disposition: Snow, return and learn/practise are distinct. A sweeping-action character is not used as wrong because Kanjipedia also recognizes sweeping senses for 彗.

漱.title: rinse the mouth; gargle
漱.disposition: Fast, drink and song/sing are not mouth-rinsing. Existing 洗 and 濯 have full three-choice curation; neither is selected as wrong here.

栞.title: bookmark; guidebook
栞.disposition: Publish/issue is an action, not the bookmark/guidebook object; floor/bed and not yet are distinct.

莉.title: jasmine in compounds
莉.disposition: Benefit, load and bitter/suffering are not jasmine. Broad flower/plant characters are not curated as wrong.
